My dear little [Maggie](../persons.html#83)
This is to wish you a very happy Christmas I think it must be happier than all the three Christmases before it, because you are old enough to know Who was born a little Baby and what the Angels came to sing while the Shepherds were watching by night.

Thank you for your pretty little note to me; and thank [Mamma](../persons.html#1019) and [Alice](../persons.html#1025) too for theirs. I hope I shall see your holly next week. I shall like so much to come. I wonder whether you will have a hymn to say to me
My little Maggie’s very affectionate Godmother

Charlotte M Yonge
